## Load Libraries

```{r load-libraries}
rm(list=ls())
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(DESeq2)
library(sva)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)

# Source custom functions
source("transcriptomics_functions.R")

out_dir = "./export/"
```

```{r load-data-models, eval=FALSE}
# Step 1: Load data
data_list <- load_transcriptomics_data(
  counts_path = './data/count_data_all.csv',
  metadata_path = "./data/metadata_ecphage.xlsx",
  annotation_path = "./data/22ET500456__with-ecolik12.csv",
  metadata_filter_col = "comment",
  metadata_filter_pattern = "missing",
  fname_col = "fname"
)

counts <- data_list$counts
metadata <- data_list$metadata
annotation <- data_list$annotation

#Step 2: remove 8 mg/L samples across times
keep_samples <- metadata %>% filter(ab_conc!=8) %>% pull(fname)
metadata_filt <- metadata %>% filter(fname %in% keep_samples)
counts_filt <- counts[,metadata_filt$fname]
metadata_filt$ab_conc <- droplevels(metadata_filt$ab_conc)


for (t in c("1h","4h","24h")){
  
  message(paste("--Identifying DEGs for: ", t))
  deseq_results <- run_DESeq2_sva(counts_filt, metadata_filt,formula_str = "~ ab_conc * phage", 
                             time_point = t)
  res_ab <- run_lfcShrink(deseq_results$dds, coef_name = "ab_conc_4_vs_0", annotation=annotation,
                          out_file = paste0(out_dir,"venn_degs_",t,"_phage0-ab4.csv"))
  res_ph <- run_lfcShrink(deseq_results$dds, coef_name = "phage_1_vs_0", annotation=annotation,
                          out_file = paste0(out_dir,"venn_degs_",t,"_phage1-ab0.csv"))
}

```

```{r}
library(patchwork)
pvenn_res <- plot_venn_diagram('./export/')
ppcoa_res <- plot_pcoa(counts_filt,metadata_filt)

write.csv(pvenn_res$count,"./export/count_venn_diagram.csv")

p<- (ppcoa_res$fig | pvenn_res$fig) 
p+ plot_layout(widths = c(1, .8))
```

##Run ORA analysis on venn regions
```{r}
pvenn_res <- plot_venn_diagram('./export/')

degs_1h_phage <- read.csv("./export/venn_degs_1h_phage1-ab0.csv")
degs_4h_phage <- read.csv("./export/venn_degs_4h_phage1-ab0.csv")

venn_degs_reg <- get_venn_region_deg_pathway(
  venn_data    = pvenn_res$data,    
  deg_1h       = degs_1h_phage,
  deg_4h       = degs_4h_phage,
  annotation   = annotation,
  output_file  = "./export/phage_venn_region_degs_annotated.csv"
)

```
```{r}
deg_df <- read.csv("./export/phage_venn_region_degs_annotated.csv")
pathway_summary <- deg_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(path_name)) %>%
  group_by(venn_group, path_name) %>%
  summarise(
    n_genes = n(),
    
    n_up   = sum(log2FoldChange > 0),
    n_down = sum(log2FoldChange < 0),
    
    fraction_up = n_up / n_genes,
    
    median_LFC = median(log2FoldChange),
    mean_abs_LFC = mean(abs(log2FoldChange)),
    
    # expression-weighted effect (optional but powerful)
    weighted_LFC = sum(log2FoldChange * log10(baseMean + 1)) /
                   sum(log10(baseMean + 1)),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(venn_group, desc(mean_abs_LFC))

pathway_summary <- pathway_summary %>%
  mutate(
    regulation_pattern = case_when(
      fraction_up >= 0.7 ~ "mostly_up",
      fraction_up <= 0.3 ~ "mostly_down",
      TRUE               ~ "mixed"
    )
  )

write.csv(pathway_summary,'./export/pathway_summary_venn-region.csv')
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

selected_pathways <- c(
  # Early phage response (1h)
  "Nitrogen metabolism",
  "Nitrogen cycle",
  "Amino sugar and nucleotide sugar metabolism",
  "2-Oxocarboxylic acid metabolism",
  "Citrate cycle (TCA cycle)",
  "Carbon metabolism",
  "Biosynthesis of amino acids",
  "Pentose phosphate pathway",

  # Sustained response (1–4h)
  "Purine metabolism",
  "Pyrimidine metabolism",
  "Pantothenate and CoA biosynthesis",
  "Biosynthesis of cofactors",
  "Ribosome",
  "ABC transporters",
  "Phosphotransferase system (PTS)",
  "Two-component system",
  "Glycine, serine and threonine metabolism",

  # Late adaptation (24h)
  "Oxidative phosphorylation",
  "Sulfur metabolism",
  "Glutathione metabolism",
  "Peptidoglycan biosynthesis",
  "Protein export",
  "beta-Lactam resistance",
  "Biofilm formation",
  "Quorum sensing",
  "Fatty acid metabolism",
  "Glycerophospholipid metabolism",
  "Nucleotide metabolism"
)

pathway_summary <- pathway_summary %>%
  mutate(
    venn_group = factor(
      venn_group,
      levels = c(
        "early_only",
        "sustained_1h",
        "sustained_4h",
        "late_emerging"
      )
    ),
    path_name = factor(path_name)
  )

plot_data <- pathway_summary %>%
  group_by(path_name) %>%
  mutate(overall_strength = max(abs(weighted_LFC), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(path_name = sub(" - Escherichia coli K-12 MG1655$", "", path_name)) %>%
  mutate(
        path_name = reorder(path_name, n_genes)
  ) 

plot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(path_name %in% selected_pathways) 

ggplot(plot_data,
       aes(y = venn_group,
           x = path_name)) +
  
  geom_point(aes(
    size  = n_genes,
    fill=weighted_LFC
  ),color = "#bdbdbd",shape =21, alpha =0.8) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#1746A2",
    mid = "#BBCB64",
    high = "#C40C0C",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Weighted\nlog2FC"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(2, 10),
    name = "DE genes"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Longitudinal phage response group",
    y = "Pathway",
    title = "Longitudinal pathway remodeling during phage exposure"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle=-90,hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y =element_text(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

```
